description: Source code for DnsUdpTracker class managing DNS UDP query tracking, entropy analysis, and related metrics.

classes.name: DnsUdpTracker
classes.description: Class responsible for tracking DNS UDP queries, detecting low entropy conditions, and recording related metrics.

classes.name: DnsUdpTracker::QueryData
classes.description: Struct representing individual DNS query data including port, query ID, and timestamp.

methods.name: DnsUdpTracker::RecordQuery
methods.description: Records a DNS query with specified port and query ID, updates low entropy status if thresholds are exceeded.

methods.name: DnsUdpTracker::RecordResponseId
methods.description: Records a DNS response ID and checks for mismatches to detect potential entropy issues.

methods.name: DnsUdpTracker::RecordConnectionError
methods.description: Handles connection errors, flags low entropy if resource exhaustion error occurs.

methods.name: DnsUdpTracker::PurgeOldRecords
methods.description: Removes outdated query and ID hit records based on maximum age thresholds.

methods.name: DnsUdpTracker::SaveQuery
methods.description: Stores a new DNS query record, maintaining maximum size constraints.

methods.name: DnsUdpTracker::SaveIdMismatch
methods.description: Tracks recognized and unrecognized ID mismatches, flags low entropy if thresholds are exceeded.
